content: Hi how can i assist you today
Street address numbers line up with dates I’m thinking about. It keeps happening on my walk.
Address sequences can overlap with many dates. Do you notice them on certain blocks or evenly across the route?
Mainly on Oak Street near the café.
Some blocks have tighter numbering and more chances for matches. Do you spot similar overlaps on a different street with longer intervals between addresses?
On Pine, the numbers jump by 20s, and I see fewer coincidences.
That difference hints at density effects. Do café trips coincide with particular times that also make the pattern feel more noticeable?
Yes, late afternoons when I’m rushing.
Rushing can make salient numbers stand out. If you pass there at a slower time, does the effect change?
Time-of-day and pace may be part of it. Noting a couple of passes at different times could help compare impressions.
I’ll try a weekend morning too.
